alert_name: C2 Beacon to Known Bad Domain

raw.detail: Periodic beaconing to known command-and-control domain

evidence: Host SALES-WKS-07 (10.20.8.55) established 58 outbound TLS connections to 203.0.113.66 (beacon.evil-c2.example) over one hour.
Connections occurred at a near-fixed 60-second interval with 8% jitter, consistent with automated C2 beaconing rather than user browsing.
Destination uses non-standard port 8443 and a JA3 fingerprint previously associated with commodity C2 frameworks.
Outbound/inbound byte ratio (142 KB out / 9.8 KB in) is consistent with beacon check-ins and small task responses.
Suricata signature 2031245 fired on the known-bad domain beacon.evil-c2.example.
